metadata.scenario: A customer expresses dissatisfaction with the quality of the recent service overhaul and requests a full review. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you? Hi, this is Helen Johnson. I wanted to discuss my recent physical therapy service. Of course, Helen. I see you've been with us for nine months. What seems to be the issue? Well, I’m really dissatisfied with the quality of the care I received during my last visit. I’m sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about what happened? The therapist seemed rushed and didn’t go through the exercises properly. I didn't feel safe. That’s certainly concerning. We prioritize safety and quality. I know, and I appreciate that. But this was not what I expected. I understand. Let me gather some details to address your concerns effectively. Thank you. I feel like my feedback is important. Definitely, Helen. We value all feedback. Could you provide me with the date of your last appointment? It was just last week, on Wednesday. Thank you. I will review the notes from that session. I’d really appreciate that. I can also arrange for another therapist to meet with you if you'd prefer. That might be a good idea. Would you like me to set up a follow-up appointment for next week with a different therapist? Yes, please. That would help. Great! I can also look into our physical therapy pricing options for you. Sure, that would be helpful. I’ll also follow up with the team about your experience and ensure we address the quality concerns. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your understanding. Of course, Helen. Just to confirm, I’ll schedule a follow-up appointment and review quality measures. Yes, that sounds perfect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that covers it. Thank you again. You’re welcome! We’ll be in touch soon. Have a great day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
